_note: 第20回（手作業で制作済み）を、自動化の書式で書き起こした見本。hero/scene/changes は実際の生成プロンプトから。

intro.front_scene: large Pon the gray-blue baby elephant stands smiling and holds up a big colorful paper map with both hands, the map showing a dotted path and four tiny pictures (a school, a red barn, a bakery, a train station) with no text and no letters; his trunk is one smooth gentle S-curve beside the map.
intro.front_motion: holds the big map steady with both hands and nods slightly
intro.prop_rule: The map keeps the same shape and the same little pictures and never bends or blurs.

words.hero: The school building (yellow walls, a red roof, a clock tower with a round clock without numbers, two arched windows and a wooden double door)
words.scene: Pon stands in front waving one arm, his trunk a smooth gentle S-curve in front of the chest.
words.changes: the waving arm is a little lower, the trunk curve changes slightly, and the two sparkles shift a little

words.hero: The hospital building (white walls, a light-blue roof, an arched entrance, a light-blue plus-shaped sign and three round windows)
words.scene: Hop stands in front of the entrance waving one hand.
words.changes: the waving hand moves slightly, and the two sparkles shift a little

words.hero: The library building (wooden walls, a green roof, a big arched window full of books and a door)
words.scene: Muffin stands in front of the door holding a big open picture book with no text in both hands.
words.changes: one page curls up a little and the book tilts slightly, and the two sparkles shift a little

words.hero: The zoo entrance (a big wooden arch gate with round decorated posts and a striped ticket booth, a giraffe's head and long neck peeking over the gate)
words.scene: Sky stands on the path in front of the gate spreading both wings in welcome.
words.changes: the giraffe's head tilts a little, the wings move slightly, and the two sparkles shift a little
words.extra_anatomy: Zoo giraffe: one long neck with one head, exactly two small horn-like knobs and two ears, drawn as one smooth shape.

words.hero: A round area of golden sand with a blue-and-white striped beach umbrella, a small sandcastle and a shell, with gentle blue waves and white foam lines behind,
words.scene: Ben stands smiling beside the umbrella.
words.changes: the foam lines of the waves change a little, one hand is slightly raised, and the two sparkles shift a little

words.hero: The farm (a big red barn with white door frames and a loft window, a wooden fence and a round hay bale)
words.scene: Pon stands in front of the barn smiling, his trunk a gentle S-curve, one arm slightly raised.
words.changes: the trunk curve changes slightly, one foot lifts a little, and the two sparkles shift a little

words.hero: The railway station (a pointed gray-blue roof, a round clock without numbers, a platform with a yellow line and a small blue train stopped beside it)
words.scene: Hop stands on the platform waving one hand.
words.changes: the waving hand moves slightly, and the two sparkles shift a little

words.hero: The airport (a terminal with big glass windows, a low control tower and a white airplane parked beside it)
words.scene: Muffin stands in front of the terminal waving one hand, a small suitcase at the feet.
words.changes: the waving hand changes slightly, and the two sparkles shift a little

words.hero: The shop (red-and-white striped awning, a big display window showing shelves of goods, a wooden crate of fruits and vegetables)
words.scene: Sky stands in front of the door holding a small woven basket with the wings, beak open, smiling.
words.changes: the basket swings a little, the wings change position slightly, and the two sparkles shift a little

words.hero: The bakery (yellow walls, a brown roof with a chimney, a big window full of bread, a display table with baguettes and round loaves out front)
words.scene: Ben stands in front smiling with both hands at the chest.
words.changes: both hands move slightly, the shape of the chimney smoke changes a little, and the two sparkles shift a little
